subject: proj
title: PROJ.-------PRI.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 461 (MP(I)-35). PROJ (projection) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PRI-INFO (principle information) is the partner. From the subject: AFI (affinity insight), PER-PHI-U-FUND and AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From AFI: AFI-2 (affinity insight—second degree) and AFI-1 (affinity insight—first degree). From PER-PHI-U-FUND: SCI-DYM (scientific dynamics) and PER-VT-U-FUND (perceived vibrational universe fundamental). From SCI-DYM: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) and AF-DR. From PER-VT-U-FUND: DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism). From DYM-SPT: POST (postulation).
